instruction: Defer publishers without documented activity since 2000; focus on newest editions first.
boundary: This is an implementation priority, not a finding of retirement or comprehensive absence. Historical-only scorecard leads are provisionally deferred and reopen upon attributable activity dated 2000 or later. Original entities and successor publishers retain separate attribution. Unknown modern activity remains unknown; no source, qualification or published row is removed.
